items.subject: AC quote for the ranch house?
items.message: hey — we're looking at a 3 ton unit for ~1800 sqft. any ballpark on pricing? also how soon could someone come out. tuesday or thursday afternoons usually work for us
items.suggestedResponse: Hi Sarah — for a 3-ton install we're usually around $4,200 all-in (labor + permits). I can hold a site visit Tue or Thu afternoon if either works. Let me know which day and I'll lock it in.

items.subject: call back — gold vs silver plan
items.message: [Phone 14:02] James called about renewing maintenance — on Silver ~4 yrs, neighbor mentioned Gold. Wants a pricing comparison emailed, said he'd "probably decide next week." OK to call back afternoons.
items.suggestedResponse: James — Gold is $29/mo (2 tune-ups, priority scheduling, 15% off repairs). Silver stays $19/mo with one tune-up. I can email the side-by-side you asked for; just reply if Gold vs Silver isn't obvious enough.

items.subject: furnace bangs when it kicks on
items.message: getting a loud bang every time the furnace starts. started last night. should i turn it off for now or is that normal-ish
items.suggestedResponse: Ryan — banging on startup isn't normal; if you smell gas, shut it off and call us. Otherwise we can usually get someone out today 2–5 PM. Can you confirm you're still at the address we have on file?
